title: 第30章 能力上交给祖国
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
蔡老太之后倒是没说啥，好似事翻篇了。

    倒是魏建业当天晚上做了美梦，梦里粮仓里堆满了粮食，老百姓天天吃净饭，就是不加地瓜不加菜的大白米饭！

    饭也是正儿八经柴火灶焖的，已经用不上一斤顶五斤的双蒸饭啦。

    老百姓不用节假日也能吃上大肥肉！

    大肥肉炖得'duang‘'duang'的

    秦瑾瑜觉得这样有损于自己的气势，于是爬到了附近的一块大石头上面，站好。

    男人一听立刻将他放下颜兮月，身体解开了束搏，那个跑在一边吐了起来，但他已经很久没吃饭，吐出来的都是黄色的水。

    苏珩拉着秦瑾瑜躲藏一阵，前方不远处一阵喧嚣声传来，竟是康王被诸多军士所团团围住。

    唐晶心本应和王欢一间，不过她却不肯，硬要单独一间，所以王欢和苏雅一间。

    唐晶心一向爱胡搅忙缠，但这两句话说得有理有据，正义凛然，竟说得季元华脸色通红，无言以对。

    ：对，他们付不起饭钱，昨天晚上花了八十多万，然后酒店报警说他们诈骗，被关进警察局了，听说还要起诉他们。

    沈清水刚想别让他靠这么近占便宜，但是听到他话，注意力就被转移了。

    也是在她说完话准备上车的时候，宋庭君不知道从哪里匆匆过来，将她的车里外看了一遍，脸上的焦急越发明显了。

    贤妃认识魏皇多年，对他颇为了解，既然问题不在魏皇身上，那就是在那个羽国使臣的身上了。

    她姑父曾庆华在学校可是著名的冷脸教授，脾气还很暴躁，从来没有学生敢逃他的课。

    娄之英暗道：“原来此人是孙兄弟的姐姐，今日若非她来，我们便要糟了。”想到此处，牵引了后背伤痛，登时疼的哼出声来。

    如此说来，秦风这次受伤到底是赚了呢？还是亏了呢？恐怕就不是一句可以道尽的了。

    萧如月原本想说，失去的亲人说不定还能再见。但这话太惊悚了，说出来怕吓着奶奶，也怕惊着别人，萧如月只好咽了回去。

    王旭耸耸肩，没有回答。场中顾梦菲已经呼喊道：“一百五十万，第三次！”将要一锤定音。

    “但事情却并没有按你的剧本发展，你的计划出现了意外，这可不像我了解的克诺比。”瑞贝卡转过头欣赏着舷窗外仍在进行的激烈魔法对撞说道。

    虞可娉道：“好，便信你说的。王捕头，午时到了，咱们走罢。”张子洞见已无事，飞脚又奔回破庙赌钱去了。

    效果很明显，一听到亲家母到了，不止老妈，老爸也隆重登场了。

    罗四娘这几日在城中行走，这些个声音她大致也都听到了，不由又佩服起罗用的先见之明。若是换了其他人，身为一个七品芝麻官，竟然还敢打破世俗给自家老妹求官，那不被人骂成神经病才怪了，搁罗用身上就不会。

    抓着司空喻一阵捶打，罗盈挣扎着便要司空喻松开，可放眼四周看去，三人的兵器已是递到了面前，近在咫尺、形势危急，司空喻又怎么会放罗盈下来。

    妮妮娅完全看呆了，等她回过神来，那套独一无二的服装已经披在了自己身上，简直是完全为她量体制作，完全没有金属冰冷生硬的感觉，而且上面还留着黄金加热后的余温。

    而剧组在国外拍摄的时候，苏云还在远程操控着「红海行动」剧组的工作。
content_en:
Mrs. Cai didn't say anything after that, as if things had changed.

    However, Wei Jianye had a sweet dream that night. In the dream, the granary was full of grain, and the people ate pure rice every day, which was white rice without sweet potatoes or vegetables!

    The rice is also cooked in a wood-fired stove, and there is no need for double-steamed rice weighing one pound to five pounds.

    Ordinary people can eat fat meat without having to take holidays!

    The big fat meat is stewed 'duang''duang'

    Qin Jinyu felt that this was detrimental to her momentum, so she climbed onto a nearby big rock and stood up.

    Upon hearing this, the man immediately put Yan Xiyue down and untied his body. The man ran aside and vomited, but he had not eaten for a long time, and all he vomited was yellow water.

    Su Heng pulled Qin Jinyu to hide for a while, when a loud noise came from not far ahead. It turned out that King Kang was surrounded by many sergeants.

    Tang Jingxin was supposed to be in the same room as Wang Huan, but she refused and insisted on being alone, so Wang Huan and Su Ya were in the same room.

    Tang Jingxin always liked to mess around, but these two sentences were so reasonable and righteous that they actually made Ji Yuanhua's face turn red and he was speechless.

    : Yes, they couldn't afford the meal and spent more than 800,000 yuan last night. Then the hotel called the police and said they were committing fraud. They were imprisoned in the police station. I heard they were going to be prosecuted.

    Shen Qingshui just wanted to stop letting him get so close and take advantage, but when she heard his words, her attention was diverted.

    It was also when she was about to get in the car after she finished speaking, Song Tingjun hurried over from nowhere and looked around her car. The anxiety on his face became more and more obvious.

    Concubine Xian has known Emperor Wei for many years and understands him quite well. Since the problem is not with Emperor Wei, it lies with the envoy of the Yu Kingdom.

    Her uncle, Zeng Qinghua, was a famous cold-faced professor in school with a very bad temper. No student ever dared to skip his classes.

    Lou Zhiying secretly thought: "It turns out that this person is Brother Sun's sister. If she hadn't come today, we would be in trouble." Thinking of this, the pain in his back was pulled, and he immediately groaned in pain.

    In this way, did Qin Feng gain from his injury this time? Or is it a loss? I'm afraid it can't be said in one sentence.

    Xiao Ruyue originally wanted to say that the lost relatives might be able to see each other again. But the words were too shocking. She was afraid of scaring her grandma and others when she said them, so Xiao Ruyue had no choice but to swallow them.

    Wang Xu shrugged and did not answer. In the field, Gu Mengfei had already shouted: "One and a half million, the third time!" The final word was about to be finalized.

    "But things did not develop according to your script. Your plan had an accident. This is not like the Kenobi I know." Rebecca turned her head and admired the fierce magic collision that was still going on outside the porthole and said.

    Yu Keping said: "Okay, I believe what you said. Wang Captou, noon is here, let's go." Zhang Zi saw that nothing happened, so he rushed back to the ruined temple to gamble.

    The effect was obvious. As soon as I heard that my mother-in-law had arrived, not only my mother, but my father also made a grand appearance.

    Luo Siniang was walking in the city these days, and she heard most of these sounds, and she couldn't help but admire Luo Yong's foresight. If it had been anyone else, as a seventh-grade sesame official, he would have dared to break the rules and ask for an official position for his sister, it would be strange not to be called a lunatic, but Luo Yong would not be the same.

    Grabbing Sikong Yu and beating her for a while, Luo Ying struggled to get Sikong Yu to let go. But looking around, the weapons of the three people were already handed in front of them. The situation was so close and critical, how could Sikong Yu let Luo Ying down.

    Niniya was completely stunned. When she came to her senses, the unique costume had been put on her body. It was completely made for her, without the cold and stiff feeling of metal, and it still retained the residual heat of heated gold.

    While the crew was filming abroad, Su Yun was still remotely controlling the work of the "Operation Red Sea" crew.
title_en: Chapter 30: Handing over abilities to the motherland
